registration_status: Local protocol fixed before simulation results; not an external registry
magnitude_formula: M(T)=4+2*log10(T/2); arbitrary reference scale, not calibrated ground motion
source_covariance: zero: deterministic causal transient, no hidden final-magnitude-dependent covariance
magnitude_prior: Discrete probabilities proportional to10^(-M), normalized on the fixed9durations; no bin-width correction
sensor_warning: Toy causal filters, not fitted StationXML or real instruments
initial_states: All path, sensor and noise states fixedzero; this assumption is shared by generator and every likelihood
preprocessing: No demeaning/detrending or normalization; no post-cutoff samples; real orthonormal Fourier basis withDC and4cos/sin pairs
template_control: Complete templates sum the entire40.5s causal signal at the prefix frequencies and fit it to prefix coefficients: intentional misspecification, not a reproduction of Caprio2011
covariance_control: Same observed-prefix noise covariance for all source hypotheses; diagonal arms discard only offdiagonals
likelihood: Normalized multivariate Gaussian including logdet and2pi term, finite gain nuisance exactly marginalized
sampling: Balanced true durations for diagnostics; gain drawn from fixed nuisance prior; same physical/count innovations reused across sensors and nested deadlines for pairing
population_metric_weight: Per-duration metrics weighted by the fixed source prior; balanced metrics reported separately
tail_definition: Synthetic M>=5, duration>=7s; this is not an INSTANCE or real EEW tail
mechanism_success_criterion: After correctness gates pass, compare prefix_full against prefix_diagonal separately at everydeadline/sensor/seed. A constructed Gaussian score advantage only motivates further physical validation; no real-data or novelty claim. No criterion tuning afterresults.
resource_bound: Local CPU only; <=15minutes simulation runtime, <=1GiB savedoutputs; no GPU/no realdata/no TEST
